thread:
maria: FYI rolled a tighter KMS condition in APAC to restrict decrypts to role-bound instances. Seeing some gpu node joins fail in ap-south 30m after the change.
jia: errors?
maria: decrypt 403 from keystore-proxy on boot for the warm pool nodes. quick grep: `DecryptDeniedException` from KMS via privatelink.
ken: omg, that's killing warmup. Any egress spikes?
ops-bot: alert: keystore-proxy 403s x 180 in 15m; affected service: gpu-warmpool-ap-south.
sre-oncall: Paging in case we need emergency rollback. Is this cross-account role boundary we tightened?
maria: yes, added `Condition: StringEquals: aws:SourceAccount` for the keystore role to enforce tenant isolation. That inadvertently blocked the provisioning role used by node bootstrap.
anas: That explains it — bootstrap uses a short-lived cross-account assume-role for provisioning. We tightened the policy but didn't update the bootstrap role mapping.
jia: immediate impact on cost: nodes keep retrying decrypts and fallback to proxy, causing NATGW egress and S3 log flushes -> higher hourly egress bill. We're seeing NAT SNAT exhaustion in one AZ.
ken: Can we short-circuit by allowing the provisioning role for a canary subset?
maria: propose three actions: 1) emergency allow provisoning-role in keystore policy and rollback condition, 2) enable 1% sampling for full KMS audit logs to cut ingest egress while we stabilize, 3) implement cached ephemeral key on the node to avoid decrypt roundtrips during bootstrap.
security-bot: note: reducing audit sampling requires Product Security sign-off for APAC compliance. Need ticket.
anas: For (3) cached ephemeral key: we can sign the bootstrap bundle with a short-lived HMAC stored in instance-identity and decrypt locally. Low risk and avoids KMS for first 90s.
sre-oncall: immediate mitigation: maria, can you amend keystore IAM to add provisoning-role ARN with a narrow Condition `ForAnyValue:StringLike` limited to `ec2:InstanceProfile`?
maria: pushing small policy tweak now to allow the node instance profile for ap-south only. Will post diff.
ops-bot: deploy started: keystore-policy patch -> staging -> prod canary (2 nodes).
ken: if canary passes, expand. Also we should throttle retry behavior on the boot agent so it doesn't batter KMS/NAT. Add exponential backoff + jitter.
jia: Good call. Also open task to review log retention: current full audit retention pushes 200MB/min from APAC keystore and we copy to central logs -> heavy egress. Sampling will help.
security-bot: I'll create the compliance PR for temporary 1% sampling and mark audit team to review. This mustn't be permanent.
anas: Longer term: recommend a keystore proxy that returns a short-lived bootstrap token signed by keystore service (no KMS decrypt in hot path). The token can't decrypt model keys but can fetch cached boot secret from regional cache.
sre-oncall: Runbook update: add step to verify `DecryptDeniedException` mapping to IAM change and execute rollback patch link: https://go/revert-keystore-policy (internal).
maria: Can confirm canary nodes joined after change. Metrics: bootstrap success increased from 60%->98% in canary. Rolling to 20% now.
ken: cost estimate: sampling + short cache should reduce egress by ~40% for the week of rollout. Please capture expected delta in cost spreadsheet.
jia: I'll update cost sheet and tag finance.
anas: Postmortem: need to track policy dep matrix — provisioning roles must be added to keystore policy docs. Also add unit test that simulates bootstrap assume-role flow.
maria: agreed. thanks all. I'll follow up with the PRs and the compliance ticket. :thumbsup:
